cohort_rule: Cohort-level transfer is supported when all six cases satisfy every criterion, or when five do and the sixth keeps its terminal survivor set and designated-grain fate.

criteria.below_persistence: lower label disagreement than static-t0 persistence at all 30 non-initial saved states
criteria.designated_grain_fate: agreement on the realized fate of one designated small grain, without reappearance
criteria.extinction_events: matching extinction count and order, with every timing residual within +/-800 steps
criteria.terminal_disagreement: terminal label disagreement at most 5% of the 2,097,152 voxels

development_cohort.description: absent from training; references examined in an earlier evaluation; not blind

near_horizon_analysis: Step-4,000 values come from an analysis carried out after the full-horizon evaluation; they are descriptive and do not define a separate qualification.

cases.success_rule: final extinction residual brought within +/-800 steps without losing another satisfied criterion
final extinction residual brought within +/-800 steps without losing another satisfied criterion

specialization.description: fixed physics-only recipe, one descendant per case from the same trained weights; 1,024 optimizer updates over a 1,024-step represented window; development cases only

training_case.role: same-initial-condition temporal extrapolation; not transfer evidence

unseen_cohort.description: absent from training; initial fields, criteria and procedure fixed before outcomes were opened; evaluated once
